interface_mismatches: The Claude Code native UI is interactive while the canonical provider factory is headless; the command must consume canonical policy and runtime configuration, then replace the process through one absolute no-PATH-search execve boundary.

Persisted run status is an observation, not a lease. Current lease requires matching execution identity and claim, acknowledgement, heartbeat, owner-policy-valid freshness, and absence of terminal, ambiguous, competing, or superseding evidence.
Generic orchestration and Mission Control own different expiry rules; the shared projection must label the owning lease policy and apply it conservatively.
Legacy terminal payloads use active names for status counts, while runtime_activity.v1 retains those fields only as compatibility aliases for current identity-bound leases.

Persisted summaries, compact app rows, repo/control parsers, and component inventory fallbacks can reintroduce false active or liveness claims unless the semantic marker is preserved and consumed end to end.
Topology active_agent and stored session status are owner-provided pointers, not process-liveness evidence, and remain separately labeled from lease-current agents and sessions.
honest_blockers: No generic read model can prove executor process liveness from persisted lease evidence; every runtime_activity.v1 projection carries proves_executor_liveness=false or an equivalent unproven label.

The effective Claude model and authentication substrate remain unknown before the native CLI starts; this packet proves transport selection, explicit-model consistency, the child-environment boundary, and absolute executable identity only.
Legacy rows lacking complete identity or lease evidence intentionally move from active counts to expired_or_unproven without database mutation or deletion.
The terminal can preserve lease evidence and liveness uncertainty but cannot probe operating-system process liveness.
Credential revocation and provider-side rotation remain external operator actions and are not performed by this repository packet.
This packet does not restart terminals, Mission Control servers, autonomous workers, or dashboards, and does not reconcile live runtime rows.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the pull request. This restores the previous routing and projection behavior but does not re-enable the independently quarantined GitHub MCP, rotate credentials, or mutate any runtime database.
